sense: above and across: fly over, spread over, cover

terms.gloss: over, above, across the top of
terms.grammar: preposition with the accusative; with the ablative mostly in verse
terms.comment: Over a thing, moving across it, spreading over it or covering it: super capita, over their heads; super rīpās, over the banks.

evidence: Verg. G. 1.364: altam suprā volat ardea nūbem
terms.comment: Higher than a thing, not touching it (see above).

evidence: Hor. Ep. 1.11.27: quī trāns mare currunt
terms.comment: Over a river, a wall, the sea: see across.

phrases.latin: Gallī occursant in rīpā cum variīs ululātibus cantūque mōris suī, quatientēs scūta super capita
phrases.english: the Gauls ran up on the bank with all kinds of howling and their customary chant, shaking their shields over their heads

phrases.latin: forte quādam dīvīnitus super rīpās Tiberis effūsus lēnibus stagnīs
phrases.english: by some chance sent by the gods the Tiber had spread over its banks in still pools

phrases.latin: caelum, nōn animum mūtant, quī trāns mare currunt
phrases.english: those who rush off over the sea change their sky, not their mind

phrases.latin: sōl nōn occidat super īrācundiam vestram
phrases.english: do not let the sun go down on your anger
